name: forgejo-mcp
description: FastMCP 3.4+ server for Forgejo and Codeberg integration (profiles, repos, issues, PRs, runners, inbox, local-LLM chat)

tools.name: forgejo_profiles
tools.description: Manage connection profiles: list, add, set_active, remove.

tools.name: forgejo_repos
tools.description: Repositories: list, create, search. Files: file_get.

tools.name: forgejo_issues
tools.description: Issues: list, create. Comments: comment (issues and PRs).

tools.name: forgejo_prs
tools.description: Pull requests: list, create, merge, diff.

tools.name: forgejo_status
tools.description: Report server health, version, profiles, and tool inventory.
